title: DAG Specification
description: Intermediate DAG specification produced during /gen-dag. Captures resolved scheduling and dependency configuration for template substitution.

platform.description: Target platform. Determines template family selection.

tenancy.description: Feature Team Name from tenancy skill (e.g., 'fdpmortgage', 'fdpcomplaints').

data_product_type.description: Data product type. Affects DAG naming and dependency patterns.

is_shared_data_product.description: True if the session target uses a shared_ prefix (e.g. shared_bdp_). Informational — does not affect DAG generation logic.

schedule_type.description: Determines which template variant to use.

schedule_hour.description: Hour for business_calendar timetable. Required when schedule_type='business_calendar'.

schedule_minute.description: Minute for business_calendar timetable. Required when schedule_type='business_calendar'.

timezone.description: IANA timezone. Fixed to Europe/London per platform standard.

skip_bank_holidays.description: If true and schedule_type='cron', inject ShortCircuitOperator as first task.

business_lag_days.description: Number of business days lag. Currently informational (driver handles lag internally).

catchup.description: Whether DAG should backfill missed runs.

sequential_processing.description: If true, each DAG run waits for the previous run to succeed before starting (depends_on_past=True, wait_for_downstream=True). If false (default), DAG runs are independent.

tables.description: One entry per target table in the session.

process_name.description: Process name for date_control and notebook params (e.g., '{schema}_{table}').

dependencies.description: Resolved upstream dependencies for this table.

dag_id.description: Upstream DAG ID. Required for dag_sensor and cross_deployment.

deployment_tenancy.description: Target Astronomer tenancy. Required for cross_deployment.

api_token_variable.description: Airflow Variable name holding API token. Required for cross_deployment.

deployment_url.description: Deployment URL pattern. Derivable from tenancy if not provided.

upstream_task.description: Specific task to wait for. Null = wait for entire DAG.

internal_task_dependency.description: Reserved — always empty. One table per DAG means no internal task dependencies.

job_accepted_params.description: Mapping of job base_parameter name (from job YAML) to Airflow XCom key. Resolved by reading generated job YAML. Only runtime-overridable params included (empty string default in base_parameters). Default: {business_date: curr_bus_dt}.

databricks_config.description: Databricks-specific configuration. Null for Glue platform.

job_name.description: Databricks job name. Derived from bundle: {schema}_{table}. Required.

itsi_env_var.description: ITSI environment variable name (e.g., 'FDPMORTGAGE_ITSI'). Used in cron template for DynamoDB sensor connection derivation. Tenancy-specific — provided by user or domain knowledge.

glue_config.description: Glue-specific configuration. Null for Databricks platform.

change_request_no.description: Change request number for Lambda payload.

csm_name.description: CSM name for Airflow connection ID derivation.

multi_table_dag.description: Deprecated — always false. One DAG per table is mandatory. Retained for schema backward compatibility.
